decisive_items: local invasion into adjacent blood vessels was seen
high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures
polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
response.rationale: R3 specifically matches malignant hepatocellular carcinoma with invasion and cytologic atypia; R2 is a generic neoplastic label; R1 is contradicted by vascular invasion.

rejected.why: Too broad, lacks specific malignant features and cell type.
Benign adenoma contradicted by local vascular invasion and malignant cytology.
